map.部署到 K8s 通常需 Deployment 与 Service 两份清单。填入: Deploying to K8s usually needs both a Deployment and a Service manifest. Enter the key parameters and this tool assembles standard YAML you can copy into the cluster and apply.
map.生成 Kubernetes 资源清单 YAML。: Generate a Kubernetes resource manifest in YAML.
map.：Deployment 的 selector 必须与 Pod template: : a Deployment's selector must match the Pod template's labels, and a Service selects Pods through its selector.
map.：requests 决定调度，limits 决定使用上限，二者应合理设置。: : requests drive scheduling and limits cap usage; set both sensibly.
map.：同时配置 readiness/liveness 探针，避免流量打入未就绪的 P: : configure readiness/liveness probes as well, so traffic does not reach a Pod that is not ready.
map.image: latest 不利于回滚与可重现部署，生产应锁定具体版本/tag: image: latest hurts rollbacks and reproducible deploys; for production, pin a specific version/tag or digest.
map.Service 的 targetPort 须与容器 containerPort: A Service's targetPort must match the container's containerPort; to expose it externally, change type to NodePort/LoadBalancer or add an Ingress.
map.生成后 kubectl apply -f 部署；变更镜像建议走滚动更新与探针（l: After generating, deploy with kubectl apply -f; when changing the image, rely on rolling updates and probes (liveness/readiness) to keep the service available.
map.分隔多文档。资源限制（resources）、探针建议另行补充。: to separate multiple documents. Add resource limits (resources) and probes yourself.
map.给新服务生成初始清单：填镜像、端口与副本数得到 Deployment 与 Ser: Generate an initial manifest for a new service: fill in image, port and replicas to get a Deployment and Service, then add probes and resource limits as needed.
map.填镜像与副本数 → Deployment + ClusterIP Service: Fill in image and replicas → Deployment + ClusterIP Service.
map.如何暴露外网？: How do I expose it externally?
map.Service 改 NodePort/LoadBalancer 或加 Ingre: Change the Service to NodePort/LoadBalancer or add an Ingress.
map.为什么要配 readiness 与 liveness 探针？: Why configure both readiness and liveness probes?
map.二者作用不同：liveness 判断容器是否存活，失败会重启；readiness: They do different jobs: liveness decides whether the container is alive and restarts it on failure, while readiness decides whether it can receive traffic and removes it from the Service back end on failure without restarting. Configuring liveness alone makes slow-starting services get killed repeatedly; together they let a service take no traffic during startup and recover automatically from a deadlock.
map.应用名取输入值（为空时用默认名），镜像取输入值（为空时用默认镜像），端口取输入值: The app name comes from the input (default name when empty), the image from the input (default image when empty), the port from the input rounded down (80 when invalid), and the replica count from the input rounded down and clamped to at least 1. The Kubernetes manifest is assembled from a template: the Deployment section writes the API version, resource kind, app name, replica count, a label selector whose value is the app name, and the container name, image and container port; then a separator introduces the Service section, which writes the API version, resource kind, app name, a selector whose value is the app name, the service port and target port (both equal to the port value above) and the cluster-internal access type. The whole YAML is HTML-escaped and displayed in a code block
